mix.name: average of the two global-branch poses at theta=0
mix.note: finite-tau Laplace mixes ~8% weight onto the two excited minima (J gap 0.034 = 3.4 tau), so the branch average has a representability floor instead of loss 0

star.name: pose of the global branch at theta*=0.10
star.note: representable target: the global branch at theta* is unique (gap 0.72), so loss(theta*) = 0

throughput.note: mode enumeration is per-sample in this implementation; a vectorised multi-instance Newton (batched over B different M) is not implemented, so the loop batch gives no speed-up
